.reboot — initialize server

Technical notes, for those who must know:

The server is a single 80486DX2 (66 MHz, the good one) in a beige
tower under the owner's desk. Initializing it flushes the world
state, re-detects the primary IDE drive (QUANTUM LP240A 540MB), and
replays the boot sequence from C:\HOUSE\TALKER.EXE. The process
takes roughly ninety seconds, during which the machine is audibly
unhappy.

WARNING: Do not run this command. Initialization interrupts every
conversation on the server, and the drive has been making a noise
lately that nobody wants to discuss. It is documented here for
completeness, in the way one documents a fire axe. If you are going
to type it anyway, at least have the decency to answer the
confirmation honestly.

The owner thanks you for not rebooting the server.
